checkpoints-obby:
local stage, ok = M.Advance(0,2); assert(stage==0 and not ok)
for i=1,4 do stage,ok=M.Advance(stage,i); assert(ok and stage==i) end
assert(select(2,M.Advance(4,4))==false)
assert(select(2,M.Advance(4,5))==false)
assert(select(2,M.Advance(0,0/0))==false)
assert(select(2,M.Advance(0,"1"))==false)
coleta-de-moedas:
local a,b=M.New(),M.New()
assert(M.Claim(a,1,0) and a.Balance==10)
assert(not M.Claim(a,1,19.99) and a.Balance==10)
assert(M.Claim(a,1,20) and a.Balance==20)
assert(M.Claim(b,1,0) and b.Balance==10)
assert(not M.Claim(a,6,100))
assert(not M.Claim(a,"1",100))
missao-de-exploracao:
local s=M.New()
assert(not M.Claim(s))
assert(M.Visit(s,1) and not M.Visit(s,1) and s.Count==1)
assert(not M.Visit(s,4))
assert(M.Visit(s,2) and M.Visit(s,3))
assert(M.Claim(s) and s.Credits==100)
assert(not M.Claim(s) and s.Credits==100)
assert(not M.Visit(s,1))
corrida-com-energia:
local s=M.New()
M.Step(s,true,false,.25); assert(s.Energy==100 and not s.Running)
M.Step(s,true,true,.25); assert(s.Energy==94 and s.Running)
for i=1,16 do M.Step(s,true,true,.25) end
assert(s.Energy==0 and s.Exhausted and not s.Running)
M.Step(s,true,true,.25); assert(s.Energy==4.5 and not s.Running)
for i=1,5 do M.Step(s,false,false,.25) end
assert(not s.Exhausted)
for i=1,100 do M.Step(s,false,false,.25) end
assert(s.Energy==100)
M.Step(s,true,true,0/0); assert(s.Energy==100)
ciclo-dia-noite:
assert(M.Sample(0).Label=="08:00")
assert(M.Sample(600).Label=="08:00")
assert(M.Sample(400).Label=="00:00" and not M.Sample(400).Day)
local noon=M.Sample(100); assert(noon.Label=="12:00" and noon.Day and noon.Brightness>2)
assert(not pcall(M.Sample,-1))
assert(not pcall(M.Sample,math.huge))
